items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Other than Fazella, you mentioned him.

ctx.x: Well, I've heard you play alto with the band, too, and clarinet.
Who are some of your favorites? Other than Fazella, you mentioned him. Oh, let's see. Well, I like quite a few around town. Bill Boudreau, I think his name is. Does he play with Mike Lawler?
